sourceOccurrences.note: IHJ3 is the countable specialization of a deterministic identity on arbitrary groups. X5NY gives the arbitrary-measure, measure-preserving-family statement; a group action and the full invariant bond law are special cases. Each explicit multiplicative theorem has a generated additive version. Full configuration-law invariance includes diagonal probabilities. Finite-cluster averaging and invariant-representative applications remain separate expository consequences.

proofUses.reason: Integrate the transport to obtain a diagonally invariant kernel, reindex by inversion, and exchange countable nonnegative sums and integrals.
The proof defines the finite-cluster transport f(omega,x)/|K_x| and applies expected mass transport under an invariant law (K5ZX).
The proof sends unit mass to the selected vertex of each infinite cluster and applies expected mass transport (K5ZX) to force the event to be null.
